text.p: The Colombian coach of Panama's soccer team, Cesar Maturana, has been sacked following the national team's poor results in World Cup qualifying games.
"The commission decided tonight to fire coach Cesar Maturana," the Panamanian soccer federation said in a communique released late on Monday evening.
It gave no reason for the dismissal of Maturana who had been hired earlier this year for a monthly salary of $5,000. It did not name a replacement.
Panama lost their first two World Cup qualifiers in the CONCACAF semifinal round, 3-1 to Canada and 3-1 at home against Cuba. They drew 1-1 against El Salvador on Sunday.
